say:0:1110906001:0.text: Hmm... There's nothing on the Quicksand Claws or the Uru Clan...
say:0:1110906001:0.source_cn: 唔，没有流沙之爪和乌尔氏族的情报……

say:1:1110906002:0.text: Where shall we go next? Keep asking around?
say:1:1110906002:0.source_cn: 接下来去哪里打听消息？再找其他人问问吗？

say:2:1110906003:0.text: I don't think we can get more out of those peddlers in town. Let's check out the notice board that Atalanta mentioned.
say:2:1110906003:0.source_cn: 镇上商贩知道的应该都差不多，去看看阿塔说的告示板吧。
